observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 180.» (L14) and «p. 181.» (L42) in the right margin. In «p. 180.» the 8 is printed broken, like an S; read as 180 between «p. 179.» (p. 118) and «p. 181.» (L42). The 0 of the line number 30 is printed broken.
body L41: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 49 the letters begin again at a.
body L5, L17, L18, L24: specks stand before «appellatur», over the u of «dum» (a round dot), under the n of «regione» and after «stella»; they are not signs.
body L11: an irregular blot joined to the s of «Solis» runs into the space before «ortum», at the height of a hyphen; it is not a hyphen.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
